title: How should support blocks be positioned in a 170-tonne thick-plate bogie-hearth furnace?
summary: For heavy thick-plate loads, check the load path at each contact from workpiece through support blocks and load-bearing columns to the bogie frame beams. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s proposal dated 5 August 2021 specifies a rated furnace load of 170 t and states that the support columns bear on the bogie's steel frame beams. Its quotation lists equipment support bases but excludes workpiece support blocks. Connect the equipment supports and buyer-supplied blocks on the loading drawing; neither 170 t nor the number of supports alone establishes a suitable arrangement.
